segments.he: וְלֹא זוֹ בִּלְבַד אָמְרוּ, אֶלָּא וְכוּ׳:
segments.en: We learned in the mishna that Rabban Gamliel told his sons: «And» that is «not only» with regard to the halakha of the recitation of Shema, «but, rather,» wherever the Rabbis say until midnight, the mitzva may be performed until dawn.

moves.summary: cites the mishna lemma to be discussed
moves.about: the mishna lemma: and not only this did they say, but wherever the Sages said until midnight the mitzva extends until dawn
